Title: Azure Automation supports .NET Framework 4.6 when running jobs within the service

Body.Content: The Azure Automation service has been upgraded to support PowerShell modules that have a dependency on .NET Framework 4.6 or lower running from the service. This will not have any impact on existing runbook jobs.
